content.user_title: Choose Your Fastest Data Monetization Path
content.value_statement: Many organizations hold valuable data but struggle to turn it into real revenue. This skill applies a seven-path model, DMS scoring, and three-database framework to pick the shortest route from data to cash.
actual_capabilities: Scores a data asset's monetization potential using the DMS model across five weighted dimensions and returns a disposition of act-now, nurture, or defer.
Compares seven monetization paths through a decision tree to recommend a primary path plus supporting paths.
Plans the three core databases (demand, data-resource, and expert/service-provider) as a reusable competitive moat.
Designs an end-to-end monetization scheme covering who to sell to, what to sell, pricing, delivery, and revenue recognition.
Guides buyer development and negotiation across five acquisition channels and produces buyer profiles, quotes, and negotiation records.
Designs a revenue structure that raises recurring revenue above fifty percent and runs quarterly monetization reviews.
limitations: Provides strategic frameworks and analysis only; it does not connect to live data sources, databases, or CRM systems.
Guidance is grounded in the author's internal knowledge base and Chinese market policy references, so specifics may need adaptation for other regions.
It does not replace licensed institutions or regulators and will not issue formal compliance or legal opinions.
Revenue figures are given as reference ranges with stated assumptions, not guaranteed outcomes.

use_cases.title: Rank monetization paths for a data asset
use_cases.description: Score a dataset with the DMS model and compare the seven paths to decide which route reaches revenue fastest.
use_cases.target_user: Data business owners and monetization leads

use_cases.title: Build a demand database from scratch
use_cases.description: Define the fields to collect and the acquisition channels needed to identify who will buy the data.

use_cases.title: Shift revenue toward recurring income
use_cases.description: Redesign a project-based revenue mix into a structure where recurring revenue exceeds half of total income.

prompt_templates.title: Quick monetization potential check
prompt_templates.prompt: We have a dataset about [describe the data]. Use the DMS model to score its monetization potential and tell me whether to act now, nurture, or defer.

prompt_templates.title: Compare the seven paths
prompt_templates.prompt: For our [describe] data assets, compare the seven monetization paths and recommend one primary path and one supporting path, with the reasoning for each.

prompt_templates.title: Design a full monetization scheme
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a complete monetization scheme for selling [data product] to [target buyer], covering what to sell, pricing, delivery, and how revenue is recognized.

prompt_templates.title: Rebalance the revenue structure
prompt_templates.prompt: Our income is mostly project-based. Design a revenue structure that raises recurring revenue above fifty percent, and outline a quarterly review plan to track progress.

output_examples.input: We hold anonymized regional consumer spending data. Score it and tell us the fastest path to revenue.
output_examples.output: The skill returns a DMS score across the five dimensions, a disposition such as act-now, and a ranked shortlist of monetization paths with the recommended primary path and the reasoning for choosing it first.

output_examples.input: Help us design a recurring revenue mix instead of one-off projects.
output_examples.output: The skill outlines a revenue structure that moves recurring income above fifty percent, names the income models to combine, and describes a quarterly review cadence to keep the mix on target.

best_practices: State your data's ownership clarity, quality, and compliance status up front so the DMS scoring is accurate.
Ask for a primary path plus supporting paths, then commit to the fastest route to first revenue before expanding.
Request reference revenue ranges with stated assumptions rather than a single fixed number.
anti_patterns: Do not treat the reference revenue ranges as guaranteed financial forecasts.
Do not skip the compliance and data-ownership gate before designing a monetization scheme.
Do not expect the skill to connect to live systems or replace licensed institutions and regulators.

faq.question: What does this skill actually do?
faq.answer: It helps you choose the shortest path to turn data into revenue, using a seven-path model, DMS scoring, and a three-database framework.

faq.question: Which AI tools support this skill?
faq.answer: It works with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code as a standard Agent Skill.

faq.question: Does it access my databases or external systems?
faq.answer: No. It provides strategy and analysis only and does not connect to live data sources or external systems.

faq.question: Is the content in English or Chinese?
faq.answer: The skill's documentation and knowledge base are primarily in Chinese, though it can respond in English on request.

faq.question: Can it guarantee how much revenue I will earn?
faq.answer: No. It provides reference revenue ranges with stated assumptions, not guaranteed outcomes.

faq.question: Does it give legal or compliance opinions?
faq.answer: No. It flags compliance and ownership as gating factors but does not replace licensed institutions or regulators.
